name: codex-context-rollover
description: Lossless one-command /clear handoff after repeated Codex compaction, anchored to exact user messages instead of another AI summary.

interface.longDescription: At the second Codex compaction, save an exact local transcript snapshot and arm a short-lived one-time handoff. When the user explicitly runs /clear, the clean session receives the original and latest exact user-message anchors—without another AI summary, blocking hook, or stale carry-over into ordinary new tasks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how the one-time /clear rollover preserves my exact objective after repeated compaction.
